DEFAULT menu.c32

  MENU LABEL vpsAdminOS >
  KERNEL menu.c32
  APPEND pxeserver/vpsadminos.cfg

  KERNEL menu.c32
  APPEND pxeserver/nixos.cfg

LABEL isoimages
  MENU LABEL ISO images >
  KERNEL menu.c32
  APPEND pxeserver/iso-images.cfg

LABEL memtest
  MENU LABEL Memtest86
  LINUX boot/memtest86/memtest.bin
  APPEND console=ttyS0

  MENU LABEL Local Boot
  LOCALBOOT 0

LABEL warm_reboot

  KERNEL reboot.c32
  APPEND --warm

LABEL cold_reboot
  MENU LABEL Cold Reboot
  KERNEL reboot.c32
